text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian suffered a defeat against 
Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide calmly analyzes the 
situation, however. Narita Brian was still 
in the Classic tier and still developing, 
meaning she had merely suffered a 
temporary defeat...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"'Only by winning again one year from now 
can it be called a true victory'... That 
is what she said. The two pledged to face 
each other once more in the Senior Class."
